title: PDE-OBS: Controlled Evaluation Across Observation Patterns
abstract: arXiv:2609.36521v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physical-field reconstruction and forecasting depend on both measurement density and spatial layout, yet evaluation under a single observation pattern does not characterize performance when that pattern changes. We introduce PDE-OBS, an integrated benchmarking platform spanning numerical data generation, model training, and inference and evaluation under varying observation conditions. It combines 560,000 fields and trajectories from seven partial differential equation families with configurable observation operators and seven adapted baseline methods for stationary reconstruction and short-horizon forecasting. Separating observation construction from physical records allows users to specify parameterized patterns and deterministic mixtures for training and testing while preserving prediction targets and data splits. translated_title: PDE-OBS：跨观测模式的受控评估
translated_abstract: 物理场重建与预测同时依赖于测量密度和空间布局，然而仅在单一观测模式下进行评估，无法刻画当该模式发生变化时模型的性能表现。我们提出了PDE-OBS，一个集成的基准测试平台，涵盖数值数据生成、模型训练，以及在不同观测条件下的推理与评估。该平台结合了来自七个偏微分方程族的56万个场和轨迹，配备可配置的观测算子，以及七种经过适配的基线方法，用于稳态重建和短期预测任务。通过将观测构建与物理记录分离，用户可以在保持预测目标和数据划分不变的前提下，为训练和测试指定参数化的观测模式以及确定性的混合模式。评估协议采用针对每个测试模式专门训练的参考模型，从而在完全相同的测试观测上对各模型进行比较……
tldr: 该论文提出了PDE-OBS集成基准平台，结合七个偏微分方程族的56万个场与轨迹及可配置观测算子，首次实现了在不同观测模式下对物理场重建与预测模型的受控、公平评估。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PDE-OBS, an integrated benchmarking platform combining 560,000 fields and trajectories from seven PDE families with configurable observation operators, enabling controlled and fair evaluation of reconstruction and forecasting models across varying observation patterns.
